issues.issue: Whether the claimants' account of Shia activism and preaching is credible
issues.applicant_position: Principal claimant says he preached Shi'ism and was threatened by Sunni extremists.
issues.result_text: Evasive, inconsistent testimony, including about converting Sunnis, undermines credibility; embellishment found.

issues.issue: Whether the 2014 break-in and 2015 shooting were targeted persecution
issues.applicant_position: Claimants say the incidents and their link to a murdered Shia doctor show they were targeted.
issues.result_text: Incidents likely random crime; delayed flight and doctor link unproven; not targeted persecution.

issues.issue: Whether Shias in Pakistan face a serious possibility of persecution or s.97 risk
issues.result_text: No serious possibility or reasonable chance of persecution or need for protection on return to Pakistan.
